title: Cyber Skeleton Over City
description: A giant cybernetic skeleton with a glowing pink skull, yellow eyes, and a VR headset stands dominantly over a futuristic city street filled with cars and crowds. Swirling colorful smoke in green, purple, and pink emanates from its body while a smaller skeleton in a top hat sits on its shoulder.
prompt: A towering cybernetic skeleton with a bright pink skull, glowing yellow eyes, and a futuristic VR visor helmet stands over a dense futuristic city street at dusk. The skeleton has mechanical legs and a glowing ribcage, wearing a dark suit jacket. A smaller skeleton in a top hat and suit sits on its shoulder. Swirling vibrant green, purple, and pink smoke and energy trails surround them. Crowds of people and colorful cars fill the streets below, with tall buildings and neon signs in the background under a dark smoky sky.
